# antigravity-priority v1.2.18-en.1

Fork release: upstream v1.2.18 merged onto v1.2.17-en.2. Everything from v1.2.17-en.2 is kept
(English-only UI in the key-model-access style, CPAMC session reuse, safe auth-file writes,
real-429-only cooldown, single runtime).

From upstream v1.2.18:

- **Probes report what really happened**: the probe API now returns per-credential outcomes. A
  single-credential probe that fails shows an error toast with the reason and HTTP status instead
  of "Credential quota updated", and a batch probe reports how many credentials failed.
- **Clearer card states**: a 429 cooldown takes precedence over other states, a failed or invalid
  probe shows a red "Probe failed" badge with the reason, and an upstream HTTP 429 that is not a
  cooldown is no longer mislabelled as one.
- **Stale quota is marked**: when a credential's quota meters come from an earlier probe rather
  than the latest one, they are dimmed and tagged "Historical".
- **Release process**: release notes are drafted from `git log <last-tag>..HEAD`, so no
  intermediate commit is left out.
